s01.text: You opened a connection. You proved it is safe. Now what? You ask for the page.

s02.text: Your browser builds an HTTP request. Method, path, headers. A plain-text letter to the server.

s03.text: It travels over your encrypted TLS tunnel. One packet at a time, across the internet.

s04.text: The server receives it. Reads the route. Finds the handler. Starts working.

s05.text: The application runs. Queries a database. Computes a response. Builds HTML or JSON.

s06.text: The response comes back. Status line. 200 OK. Headers. Body. Encrypted, sent back.

s07.text: Packets flow back across the same path. Your browser receives them, in order, thanks to TCP.

s08.text: Your browser parses the HTML. Builds the DOM. Fetches CSS, images, JavaScript.

s09.text: Remember the two hundred milliseconds? DNS, TCP, TLS, HTTP. They all fit inside it.

s10.text: Next: how those bytes reach millions of users at once. CDNs and the edge.
